spans.s: शु [śu], 1 P. (शवति) To go; L. D. B.
शु [śu] शकम् [śakam], शकम् ind. Quickly, swiftly.
To make firm or steady, stop.
P. (सवति, सौति) To possess power or supremacy. -
. U. (सुनोति, सुनुते; सुत; the स् of सु is changed to ष् after any preposition ending in इ or उ)
To press out or extract juice.
To pour out, sprinkle, make a libation.
To perform a sacrifice especially the Soma (sacrifice).
To churn.-Desid. (सुषूषति-ते) With उद् to excite, agitate. -प्र to produce, beget.
सु [su], ind. A particle often used with nouns to form Karmadhāraya and Bahuvrīhī compounds, and with adjectives and adverbs. It has the following senses:
Well, good, excellent; as in सुगन्धि.
Beautiful, handsome; as in सुमध्यमा, सुकेशी &c.
Well, perfectly, thoroughly, properly; सुजीर्णमन्नं सुविचक्षणः सुतः सुशासिता स्त्री नृपतिः सुसेवितः ......सुदीर्घकाले$पि न याति विक्रियाम्
Easily, readily, as in सुकर or सुलभ q. v.
Much, very much, exceedingly; सुदारुण, सुदीर्घ &c.
It is also said to have the senses of assent, prosperity, and distress.-Comp. -अक्ष a.
